🌱 Certificate Achievement: NESTGEN 2026 – Finance & Entrepreneurship Masterclass, Nestlé Youth Entrepreneurship Program

Excited to share that I've completed the Finance & Entrepreneurship masterclass as part of Nestlé's NESTGEN E-Learning Festival 2026! 🎓
This program strengthened my skills in Start-up Acceleration and Entrepreneurship giving me valuable insight into how global brands like Nestlé are investing in the next generation of innovators and problem-solvers.
As a chemistry 👩🏻‍🔬 graduate building a career in Quality Control and Laboratory Analysis, I believe understanding entrepreneurship and business fundamentals is just as important as technical expertise — it shapes how I think about innovation, efficiency, and value creation in any organization I work with.
Grateful to Nestlé Asia, Oceania & Africa for creating this opportunity for young professionals like me to keep learning and growing. 🙌
📌 Always open to connecting with professionals in Chemistry, QC/QA, R&D, and Food Safety — let's grow together!
